notes.title: New Revenge Chapter Update Released!
notes.content:
What’s New in This Update?
After descending the mountain, a whole new stage begins — the Revenge Chapters. In this update, you’ll infiltrate enemy strongholds, confront your rivals face to face, and settle unfinished scores.

Multiple enemy territories are now open to explore and conquer.

A variety of new weapons are available to aid you in your battles.

Each mission brings you closer to vengeance and the truth behind your enemies.
